# Point Last Seen

> A search-planning tool for missing-person searches. The command post shows where to search first as a probability map over a park's search segments, and updates the map and the team plan as sightings, clues and cleared segments come in. It runs on Firebase AI Logic with hybrid inference: private reads (a family photo, a caller's note) stay on the laptop's built-in Chrome model, and cloud reads happen only after a consent tap. Everything shown is a training drill: nobody is missing.

## Start here

- [Judge's door](/judge): no login and no key. Explains what to try, names the cloud model in use, and readies this laptop's built-in model.
- [Command post](/): join an incident with its id and join code.

## Notes

- Drill and practice data only; no real person is tracked.
- Location and model choices are explained on the judge's door.
